name: Artur Karapetian
bio: I build software, AI systems, and the infrastructure behind them. I started coding at 13; math and game theory pulled me into AI. I still like following a question all the way to something I can ship.

now.name: Runtools
now.description: custom software, AI systems, and infrastructure for agents.

before: Co-founded [LoadGuard](https://loadguard.ai/), built insurance software with [QuoteCraft](https://quotecraft.org/), and worked on game theory AI research at Arizona State. Our project Cosmo placed **Top 10 at a Y Combinator hackathon** and became the starting point for Runtools.
